lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs to form a grid-like topology across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is present along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient from high-intensity dorsal pixels to low-intensity ventral shadow pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High density of small, high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the first dorsal fin, with increased concentration along the anterior leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch is present on the trailing (posterior) edge of the first dorsal fin, disrupting the expected continuous curve of the silhouette.
